title: plugin-grid: list inline edit saves without If-Match, so a stale grid edit silently overwrites a concurrent write (data integrity) — defaultRowSave / defaultBatchSave call dataSource.update with no optimistic-concurrency token
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict · N2

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (`plugin-grid`). **Data integrity:** a write the user never saw is lost with a 200 and no signal. **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "grid inline edit save without If-Match optimistic concurrency silent overwrite last write wins ObjectGrid" — 30 hits; none covers the record grid. The sibling shape on Studio metadata drafts is objectui#11773 (open) — same defect form, different save path and fix site.

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, `--seed-admin`, admin persona. Reproduced twice on fresh loads by the runner; mechanism confirmed in source by the PM seat; not a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the implicated files).

## Reproduction

1. Open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/view/grid` (inline edit on); note a row's Estimate (e.g. "Ingest pipeline" = 60).
2. Concurrently: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` `{estimate_hours: 77}` with `If-Match` = its `updated_at` → 200.
3. In the stale grid, set that row's Estimate to 61, Enter, click "Save All (1)".
4. Captured `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` body `{estimate_hours: 61}` with **no `If-Match`** → 200; re-read → 61. No 409, no conflict dialog, no toast. Reproduced twice (Ingest pipeline 77 → 61, Warehouse schema 33 → 31).

**Expected:** the grid save carries the row's concurrency token, the stale write is refused 409, and the console's conflict dialog appears — the checklist item names a save that omits `If-Match` a FAIL.

## Mechanism (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

`packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` `defaultRowSave` → `dataSource.update(objectName, id, changes)` and `defaultBatchSave` → the same call per row; neither passes the row's version as `ifMatch`.
